mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.vps_host_id AS vpsHostId, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, vh.name AS vpsHostName, vh.origin AS vpsHostOrigin, vh.status AS vpsHostStatus, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, CASE WHEN ut.entry_address_mode = 'CUSTOM' THEN selected_domain.domain WHEN ut.entry_address_mode = 'DEFAULT' THEN default_domain.domain ELSE NULL END AS entryDomain, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN user_tunnel ut ON ut.user_id = f.user_id AND ut.tunnel_id = f.tunnel_id LEFT JOIN tunnel_entry_domain selected_domain ON selected_domain.id = ut.entry_domain_id AND selected_domain.tunnel_id = f.tunnel_id AND selected_domain.status = 1 LEFT JOIN tunnel_entry_domain default_domain ON default_domain.id = ( SELECT MIN(default_candidate.id) FROM tunnel_entry_domain default_candidate WHERE default_candidate.tunnel_id = f.tunnel_id AND default_candidate.is_default = 1 AND default_candidate.status = 1 ) LEFT JOIN vps_host vh ON f.vps_host_id = vh.id ORDER BY f.created_time DESC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.vps_host_id AS vpsHostId, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, vh.name AS vpsHostName, vh.origin AS vpsHostOrigin, vh.status AS vpsHostStatus, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, CASE WHEN ut.entry_address_mode = 'CUSTOM' THEN selected_domain.domain WHEN ut.entry_address_mode = 'DEFAULT' THEN default_domain.domain ELSE NULL END AS entryDomain, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN user_tunnel ut ON ut.user_id = f.user_id AND ut.tunnel_id = f.tunnel_id LEFT JOIN tunnel_entry_domain selected_domain ON selected_domain.id = ut.entry_domain_id AND selected_domain.tunnel_id = f.tunnel_id AND selected_domain.status = 1 LEFT JOIN tunnel_entry_domain default_domain ON default_domain.id = ( SELECT MIN(default_candidate.id) FROM tunnel_entry_domain default_candidate WHERE default_candidate.tunnel_id = f.tunnel_id AND default_candidate.is_default = 1 AND default_candidate.status = 1 ) LEFT JOIN vps_host vh ON f.vps_host_id = vh.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
